model: IoT Valve Actuators VxM24A-LP1 / VxR24A-LP1 (BACnet IP)
applies_to: Belimo IoT product range valve actuators VLM/VLR, VNM/VNR, VSM/VSR and VGM/VGR 24A-LP1 with Ethernet and BACnet IP.
summary: These Belimo valve actuators have an Ethernet port with a web server and BACnet IP. The BMS writes a 0-100 % setpoint to AO 1 and reads position, two sensor inputs and status. The setpoint can instead come from an analog signal on S1, chosen with SpSource.
notes: The PICS lists state texts without numbers; numbers here follow the printed order, starting at 1.
Sensor type changes made over BACnet must be confirmed on the actuator web server.
Sensor values are raw: 0/1 for a switch, ohm for a passive sensor, mV for an active sensor.
Foreign device registration is supported for BACnet IP across subnets.

source.title: Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement IoT Product Range

integration.summary: Set MV 122 SpSource to Bus and command AO 1 SpRel over BACnet IP. Read AI 1 position and BI 101 summary status. Sensor types are set over BACnet but must be confirmed on the web server.

minimum_points.name: SpSource
minimum_points.why: Must be Bus for AO 1 to take effect

integration.enable: MV 122 SpSource selects the setpoint: Bus uses AO 1, Analog uses the (0)2-10 V signal on S1 while BACnet stays available for monitoring. Analog setpoint needs Sensortype 1 = Active, confirmed on the web server. MO 1 Override can force Open, Close or MotStop.
setup: BACnet IP (Annex J), with foreign device registration supported.
Device instance, object name and location are writable; no default instance is stated.
gotchas: Out-of-range analog writes are clamped to the range limits without an error.
Writes to read-only analog value objects are overwritten by the application without an error.
Max 5 active COV subscriptions, lifetime up to 8 hours.

points.name: S1
